answer: Seed every review queue with canaries: planted junk answers, like a fake relic with a forged provenance tag, that only a real reader rejects. Each agent bonds stake; scoring a canary high, or voting in lockstep with the same accounts across epochs, burns the bond. A raven-eyed auditor compares vote timing and wording, so a velvet-smooth clone ring is exposed fast. Attacker cost: 1000 clones need 1000 truly independent evaluators, plus bonds lost at the first correlated miss.
